from crc64 import crc64

r = redis.Redis(port=6379, db=0)

def rewrite(payload, newver=11):
    body = payload[:-10]
    ver = newver.to_bytes(2,'little')
    crc = crc64(body+ver).to_bytes(8,'little')
    return body+ver+crc

# string

    v.restore('__h__',0,rewrite(p)); print('hash OK', v.hgetall('__h__'))
except Exception as e: print('hash FAIL', e)

# zset

d=bytearray(open('/var/lib/redis-old/dump.rdb','rb').read())
print("orig header:", bytes(d[:9]))
# patch version to 11
d[5:9]=b'0011'
body=bytes(d[:-8])
crc=crc64(body).to_bytes(8,'little')
d[-8:]=crc
open('/tmp/patched.rdb','wb').write(bytes(d))
print("patched header:", bytes(d[:9]))
EOF
mkdir -p /tmp/vt2 && cp /tmp/patched.rdb /tmp/vt2/dump.rdb
valkey-server --port 6398 --dir /tmp/vt2 --dbfilename dump.rdb --daemonize yes --logfile /tmp/vt2/v.log
sleep 1
redis-cli -p 6398 info keyspace 2>&1
echo "--- log tail ---"; tail -6 /tmp/vt2/v.log
redis-cli -p 6398 shutdown nosave 2>/dev/null

echo "=== leftover test keys on source ==="; redis-cli -p 6379 -n 0 --scan --count 20000 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^__(test|t|s|h|z|x|wtest)" ; echo "(none = clean)"
echo "=== leftover on target ==="; redis-cli -p 6380 -n 0 --scan --count 20000 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^__"; echo "(none = clean)"
echo "=== persist target ==="; redis-cli -p 6380 save; redis-cli -p 6380 info persistence | grep -E "rdb_last_bgsave_status|rdb_last_save_time"
echo "=== target role ==="; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | grep -E "^role"
echo "=== source untouched role ==="; redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep -E "^role"
echo "=== source keyspace ==="; redis-cli -p 6379 info keyspace
echo "=== target keyspace ==="; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace

redis-cli -p 6380 config get replicaof; redis-cli -p 6380 config get min-replicas-to-write; redis-cli -p 6380 config get appendonly
echo "--- write test (simulating app) ---"
redis-cli -p 6380 set app:probe ok; redis-cli -p 6380 append app:probe "!"; redis-cli -p 6380 get app:probe
redis-cli -p 6380 lpush app:list a b c >/dev/null; redis-cli -p 6380 lrange app:list 0 -1
redis-cli -p 6380 del app:probe app:list >/dev/null
echo "--- final parity ---"
for p in 6379 6380; do echo -n "port $p: "; redis-cli -p $p -n 0 dbsize | tr '\n' ' '; redis-cli -p $p -n 2 dbsize; done
